name: Barcode
description: Shows a barcode for an ID you supply: a parkrun athlete ID, a membership number, a transit pass. Code 128 by default, or a QR code per code where whatever scans it uses a camera. Holds up to six, cycled on the watch. The IDs come from your phone; the watch only draws them.

configFields.label: Code 1 ID
configFields.description: The value encoded in the barcode: a parkrun athlete ID, a membership number, a transit pass. Copy it exactly as case matters.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 plain characters, copied exactly. Case matters.

configFields.label: Code 1 name
configFields.description: Optional label so you can tell your codes apart. It is not part of the barcode, and a QRCode does not show it.

configFields.label: Code 1 format
configFields.description: Either Code128 or QRCode. Code128 is the ordinary barcode and every scanner reads it.
